newsitem.title: OMAN: Heavy response to Oman mushroom company IPO.
newsitem.headline: Heavy response to Oman mushroom company IPO.

text.p: There has been a heavy response to the initial public offer of 800,000 shares in the Gulf Mushroom Products Company, a banking source in Oman said on Tuesday.
The new company will produce 3,120 tonnes of mushrooms a year, 1,000 tonnes will be fresh mushrooms while the rest will be processed.
"The response (to the offering) was excellent and we expect an increase in demand as we approach the closing date for subscriptions on August 6," the source said.
The company is being set up with an authorised capital of 2.5 million rials distributed on 2.5 million shares, each share to cost one rial.
Paid-up capital was put at two million rials of which 1.2 million was paid by the founders.
